282042319.description:
Waterman's
Black Dip Pen with Original Presentation Case
Early to Mid-20th Century
This vintage Waterman's writing instrument features a slender, elongated black tapered staff paired with a decorative gold-tone ferrule and metal nib assembly with an attached reservoir clip. Housed in an authentic hinged Waterman's clamshell presentation case with cream-colored ribbed fabric lining and branded silk-screened satin lid, this piece exemplifies classic early to mid-20th century desk pen design and stationery presentation.
Black finished tapered staff holder with knurled gold-tone metal ferrule collar
Fitted metal writing nib featuring an integrated ink reservoir attachment
Authentic hinged Waterman's presentation box with tan textured exterior and lined interior
"Waterman's" maker name clearly printed across the interior lid satin liner
Pen length measures approximately 8 inches overall
Condition:
Vintage condition consistent with age and prior use. Staff shows light surface wear and minor scuffing along the black finish. The metal nib displays significant ink residue, surface oxidation, and finish wear across the reservoir clip. Presentation case hinges properly and latches securely; interior satin exhibits light foxing and ink staining along the edge corners, with exterior showing minor shelf wear.

281660373.description:
Natural Amethyst Quartz Crystal Cluster Lot
Rough Mineral Specimens, 4 Pieces
Natural Geode and Druzy Formations, Brazil
This collection features four natural raw amethyst and quartz crystal specimens showcasing distinct geological crystal habits and coloration. Sourced from crystalline basalt geode deposits, these specimens display varied shades ranging from delicate lilac to deeper violet druzy terminated points resting on natural matrix bases.
Items Included:
Elongated quartz and light amethyst druzy cluster on dark basalt matrix with "Made in Brazil" label
Lavender botryoidal druzy cluster formation with subtle amber-toned quartz center
Upright amethyst cluster featuring distinct pyramidal crystal terminations on rough matrix
Sliced geode section displaying violet amethyst crystallization edged in white quartz
Condition:
All specimens are in natural rough state with naturally occurring crystalline terminations, surface texture, and matrix rock intact. Natural fractured edges, matrix variations, and mineral inclusions are present throughout as expected with raw earth stones. Original country of origin sticker remains affixed to one specimen.

281714040.description: This lot includes four vintage used vacuum tubes from National brand: 2C39 and 7289 models. Made in the USA, these tubes feature metal and ceramic construction. They were typically used as radio frequency power amplifiers in industrial, military, and amateur radio equipment. Tubes show signs of wear and oxidation, with handwritten notes on bases indicating previous use and condition, such as 'R. Final 2C39 5-20-85 USED' and '+V.G.++'. All tubes appear structurally intact but are sold as used and may require testing or refurbishment before operational use. Suitable for collectors, restorers, or those needing period-correct replacements for vintage RF or transmitter gear. not tested
